name: Assassin 101
source:
Ever curious of how to be an assassin? Well, this course teaches you  ̶e̶v̶e̶r̶y̶t̶h̶i̶n̶g̶(nothing) it really takes to be an assassin!

Or, have fun playing as a newbie assassin on their first mission assignment! See if you can work it out on your first run!

[From [url=https://naomigm.itch.io/assassin-101]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有没有好奇如何成为一名刺客？好吧，这门课程教你 ̶e̶v̶e̶r̶y̶t̶h̶i̶n̶g̶（没什么）成为一名刺客真的需要！

或者，在第一个任务任务中扮演新手刺客，享受乐趣！看看你是否能在第一次跑步时解决这个问题！

[来自[url=https://naomigm.itch.io/assassin-101]Itch.io[/url]]
